source_binding_attestation.bijection_rule: the verifier privately recomputes each alias binding and proves its service/boot pair multiset equals the active complete unordered service/boot pair multiset exactly once each, with exact frozen authorities and two distinct database digests; no array-index inference is allowed
source_binding_attestation.core_rule: rebuild sources.source_binding_core from alias_ids_by_alias, the equal pre database map, the equal pre binding map, and active_services_state_sha256; source_binding_core_sha256_and_bytes.sha256 is SHA-256 of the declared domain preimage and .bytes is the byte length of that same preimage
source_binding_attestation.marker_chain_rule: attestation_attempt_marker is validator-valid with the same segment_index; initial uses initial-source-binding/slot 0/null closure and successor uses successor-segment/null slot/the exact predecessor closure; previous_ledger_entry_sha256 is the attempt marker ledger head
source_binding_attestation.time_rule: pre_observed_at is the launcher sample immediately before the first pre metadata observer and post_observed_at immediately follows the final post metadata observer; pre_observed_at < post_observed_at and both are row-blind; for initial binding attempt.written_at <= pre_observed_at < post_observed_at < its start_deadline_at, and the frozen implementation ordering plus fault-point tests enforce completion before key creation/source open while the ledger proves marker -> binding -> later resolution order; for a successor they equal the enclosing segment attestation pre_launcher_at and post_launcher_at

runtime_segment_attestation.identity_rule: segment_id is recomputed with domains.successor_segment_id_preimage; active_services_state_sha256 equals the hash in complete_unaliased_service_tuple_sha256_and_bytes; attestation_attempt_marker is the sole marker for this predecessor closure; the source-binding artifact validates independently and its pre/post observations equal this receipt's pre_launcher_at/post_launcher_at
runtime_segment_attestation.marker_chain_rule: the segment attestation and referenced source-binding attestation carry the same validator-valid attempt-marker identity, segment_index, and predecessor-closure hash; previous_ledger_entry_sha256 equals the source-binding ledger head
runtime_segment_attestation.time_rule: pre_launcher_at <= boundary_launcher_at; boundary_at equals max(boundary_launcher_at, both pre_source_clock_observed_at_by_alias values); lower_bound_exclusive_at equals boundary_at; every retained service boot_started_at is <= its corresponding pre observation; post_phase_started_at >= boundary_at + 0.25 seconds; every post source clock and post_launcher_at is greater than boundary_at; post_launcher_at - pre_launcher_at is less than 300 seconds

successor_attestation_attempt_marker.conditional_rule: initial-source-binding requires segment_index=0, slot_index_or_null=0, null predecessor closure, authorized_at equal schedule.first_slot_at, probe-attempt.launched_at <= written_at <= source-binding.pre_observed_at < start_deadline_at equal slot-0 grace deadline; successor-segment requires null slot, segment_index=predecessor+1, nonnull closure, authorized_at equal closure.validated_at, closure.validated_at <= written_at <= segment.pre_launcher_at < start_deadline_at equal closure.validated_at+30 seconds
successor_attestation_attempt_marker.attempt_rule: write/fsync the initial marker immediately after the slot-0 probe-attempt ledger entry, or the successor marker immediately after the slot-closure ledger entry, then append its own ledger entry before either pre observer; these are ordered separate writes, and a crash/missing marker or ledger gap terminalizes through runtime_attestation_terminal_marker by start_deadline_at without authorizing another marker

runtime_attestation_terminal_marker.marker_nullability: attempt marker is null only for attempt-marker-create-failure, invalid collision, attempt-start-late, worker-crash-or-eof before durable marker validation, or watchdog-timeout before durable marker validation; predecessor closure is null only for initial-source-binding

slot_segment_closure_resolution.mismatch_rule: recompute exactly with runtime_segments.closure_mismatch_kinds_rule from the four retained content-addressed objects; unavailable or structurally invalid observation is never a closure
slot_segment_closure_resolution.attestation_rule: segment 0 attestation identity equals the pinned release control watermark; a successor equals its validator-valid runtime_segment_attestation artifact; segment_index and segment_id equal that attestation
slot_segment_closure_resolution.identity_rule: resolution_id is recomputed exactly with domains.slot_resolution_id_preimage
slot_segment_closure_resolution.time_rule: scheduled_at is the exact lattice time, grace_deadline_at = scheduled_at + 21600 seconds, and scheduled_at <= launched_at <= validated_at < grace_deadline_at

slot_probe_resolution.count_rule: selected_event_count equals selected_replayable_event_count plus selected_nonreplayable_event_count; every count is a nonnegative non-boolean integer
slot_probe_resolution.decision_rule: status is ready iff every readiness.scheduled_ready_floor_groups_exactly floor passes on the complete replayable population; post_run_evidence_floor is never an input; otherwise status is below-floor
slot_probe_resolution.runtime_binding_rule: release_effective_at equals the pinned 2026-08-14T15:03:46.793603Z; segment_id and active_segment_lower_bound_exclusive_at equal the referenced active segment; source_binding_attestation_sha256_and_bytes equals its active validator-valid binding artifact; pre_active_services_state_sha256 equals post_active_services_state_sha256 and the active segment digest; both pre/post database maps and both pre/post binding maps are pairwise equal and rebuild that active source-binding core; any mismatch cannot produce below-floor or ready
slot_probe_resolution.identity_rule: resolution_id is recomputed exactly with domains.slot_resolution_id_preimage
slot_probe_resolution.time_rule: scheduled_at is the exact lattice time, grace_deadline_at = scheduled_at + 21600 seconds, and scheduled_at <= launched_at <= validated_at < grace_deadline_at
slot_probe_resolution.snapshot_rule: aliased_source_snapshot_sha256_and_bytes has exactly local and alt hash/byte identities and their SHA-256 values are distinct
slot_probe_resolution.segment_attestation_rule: for segment 0, segment_attestation_sha256_and_bytes equals the pinned release control-watermark SHA-256/bytes; for a successor it equals that segment's validator-valid runtime_segment_attestation artifact
slot_probe_resolution.conditional_rule: below-floor requires null seal-consumption and sealer-launch fields; ready requires both nonnull and is valid only after readiness.atomic_ready_handoff

post_build_runtime_observation.equality_rule: both observed objects equal the active segment and source-binding attestation byte-for-byte and the snapshot set equals the atomic handoff; mismatch or unavailability cannot produce this receipt

probe_attempt_marker.attempt_ordinal: first attempt in a slot is integer 0 and every authorized retry is exactly prior attempt_ordinal + 1; booleans, skips, reuse, and reset are invalid
probe_attempt_marker.watchdog_rule: watchdog_deadline_at is the earlier of launched_at + 3600 seconds and grace_deadline_at minus 60 seconds; launches at or after that latest permissible instant are rejected before marker creation; unresolved workers are conservatively terminalized at the watchdog, leaving the fixed 60-second fsync margin
probe_attempt_marker.time_rule: scheduled_at is the exact lattice instant; grace_deadline_at is scheduled_at + 21600 seconds; scheduled_at <= launched_at < watchdog_deadline_at < grace_deadline_at

probe_failure_marker.phase_value_rule: known phases require source_open_count integer 0..2 and boolean key_created consistent with the phase; unknown-after-attempt requires both fields null, controller_synthesized true, failure_class post-source-terminal, and retry_authorized false
probe_failure_marker.authority_boundary_rule: atomic-seal-handoff is valid only before a seal-consumption marker exists; marker creation transfers every later failure exclusively to seal_terminal_receipt
probe_failure_marker.attempt_binding_rule: slot_index and attempt_ordinal equal the referenced validator-valid probe-attempt marker and previous_ledger_entry_sha256 is its ledger head
probe_failure_marker.retry_equivalence: only ordinary probe work after a validator-valid source binding may set retry_authorized true, exactly when phase is pre-key-pre-source, source_open_count_or_null is 0, key_created_or_null is false, controller_synthesized is false, and failure_class is pre-source-retryable; runtime/source-binding ceremonies never use this marker
probe_failure_marker.watchdog_synthesis: worker crash, EOF, or hang with unproved progress emits unknown-after-attempt at the referenced attempt watchdog deadline and immediately enters terminal-probe-integrity-failure

missed_slot_marker.time_rule: scheduled_at is the exact lattice instant for slot_index, grace_deadline_at = scheduled_at + 21600 seconds, and recorded_at >= grace_deadline_at
missed_slot_marker.precondition: no validator-valid slot resolution exists for slot_index and no attempt artifact proves any source open; the marker is the immutable terminal resolution and no retry follows

horizon_terminal_marker.exact_rule: final_slot_index is 28, absolute_horizon_expires_at is 2026-09-14T06:00:00.000000Z, recorded_at >= that instant, and final_slot_resolution_sha256_and_bytes resolves to slot 28 with below-floor exactly for final-slot-below-floor or segment-closed exactly for final-slot-segment-closed

ledger_entry.slot_index_or_null: segment-attestation is null; runtime-attestation-attempt, runtime-attestation-terminal, and source-binding-attestation are 0 for initial-source-binding and null for successor-segment; all probe/resolution/seal/horizon artifacts carry their exact slot
ledger_entry.entry_index_rule: entry_index is 0 for the first entry and exactly predecessor.entry_index + 1 thereafter; reuse, skip, negative, or boolean is invalid
ledger_entry.genesis_rule: entry 0 is segment-attestation pointing to the exact release control-watermark SHA-256/bytes and its previous_ledger_entry_sha256 equals domains.ledger_genesis_value

artifact_kind_rule.segment-attestation: control-watermark for entry 0 or runtime-segment-attestation for successors

ledger_entry.bootstrap_and_successor_order: entry 0 control-watermark segment -> slot-0 probe-attempt -> initial runtime-attestation-attempt -> initial source-binding -> continuation of that same slot-0 probe without a second attempt marker; for a changed slot 0..27: slot-segment-closed -> successor runtime-attestation-attempt -> successor source-binding -> successor segment-attestation; slot-28 closure goes only to horizon; each artifact's own previous_ledger_entry_sha256 equals the immediate prior ledger head
ledger_entry.hash_derivation: domains.ledger_entry_preimage and ledger_entry_value; artifact identity resolves through common_validation.content_addressed_artifact_resolution and its receipt kind/status must match artifact_kind_rule

seal_consumption_marker.snapshot_rule: snapshot_set_sha256_and_bytes is recomputed from the exact ready resolution aliased_source_snapshot_sha256_and_bytes with domains.snapshot_set_preimage/value

probe_terminal_marker.precondition: failure_class is post-source-terminal; no missed-slot marker and no retry

seal_terminal_receipt.sealed_conditional_fields: status sealed requires null failure fields and every *_or_null artifact nonnull
seal_terminal_receipt.watchdog_rule: after a semantically valid seal marker, every pre-gate handoff stage shares one deadline marker.consumed_at+30 seconds; watchdog_deadline_at_or_null equals marker.consumed_at+3600 seconds and forced_termination_deadline_at_or_null equals watchdog+30 seconds; both watchdog fields are null exactly when no semantically valid marker exists
seal_terminal_receipt.marker_identity_rule: marker-create-failure has a null marker identity; marker-collision or marker-validation-failure may carry the hash/byte identity of resolvable invalid bytes but those bytes are expected to fail semantic validation; every later stage requires a nonnull semantically validator-valid marker
seal_terminal_receipt.time_rule: a marker-create, marker-collision, or marker-validation failure completes inside the originating slot grace; every other pre-gate failure and the ready resolution validated_at are at or before marker.consumed_at+30 seconds; sealed or non-timeout post-gate completion is at or before watchdog_deadline_at; timeout completes from watchdog_deadline_at through forced_termination_deadline_at inclusive; forced-termination completes exactly at forced_termination_deadline_at; no deadline resets on recovery
seal_terminal_receipt.ledger_predecessor_rule: marker-create and proven-absent marker-ledger failures append from pre-consumption head H; a marker-ledger write/fsync error is resolved read-only at the unique entry path: exact valid intended M becomes authoritative and recovery continues from M, proven absence terminalizes from H, and invalid/partial/colliding bytes cause terminal integrity escalation without writing an alternate branch; spawn through blocked-child failures append from M; build through validation/watchdog failures and sealed success append from atomically visible ready head R; no branch, skipped predecessor, or fabricated M/R is valid
seal_terminal_receipt.cross_artifact_rule: every present snapshot_set_sha256_and_bytes equals the seal marker, ready resolution, post-build observation, and packet manifest identity; every present slot/manifest artifact and every marker except the explicitly expected invalid marker cases resolves and validates rather than matching by digest spelling alone
seal_terminal_receipt.failure_conditional_fields: status terminal-seal-failure requires nonnull stage/reason permitted by stage_reason_matrix; marker nullability follows marker_identity_rule, slot resolution may be null only before the ready bundle becomes visible, post-build observation may be null before that phase, for observation-unavailable, or at watchdog failure, manifest/verifier may be null before their phases, and no absent artifact may be fabricated

implementation_stack_freeze_receipt.time_rule: frozen_at is the single durable transition instant after every implementation, evaluator, calculator, configuration, threshold, dependency/environment, runtime-setting, resolver, and arm-schedule member is content-hash bound and before development calibration
implementation_stack_freeze_receipt.binding_rule: stack_binding_sha256_and_bytes resolves as the exact frozen measurement stack required by hash_binding.evaluation_receipt_must_bind; packet and plan identities match that stack object; overwrite, alternate freeze receipt, or mutable-name-only binding is invalid

pre_reader_launch_attempt_marker.creation: one O_CREAT|O_EXCL regular non-symlink marker per exact phase, fsynced before process spawn; creation consumes that phase and overwrite, second marker, second process, alias, or retry is invalid
pre_reader_launch_attempt_marker.predecessor_rule: development-calibration predecessor resolves as implementation_stack_freeze_receipt and public-evaluation predecessor resolves as development_terminal_receipt with terminal_status pass; packet, stack, and plan identities are equal
pre_reader_launch_attempt_marker.time_rule: consumed_at is at or after predecessor.frozen_at for development or predecessor.terminated_at for public; start_deadline_at is exactly that predecessor instant+30 seconds; consumed_at and process launch are no later than start_deadline_at; watchdog_deadline_at equals that same predecessor instant+3600 seconds and never resets

development_terminal_receipt.time_rule: implementation_stack_freeze_receipt resolves and state_entry_at equals its frozen_at; a present launch marker has phase development-calibration, watchdog_deadline_at equal state_entry_at+3600 seconds, and a process launch has marker.consumed_at <= launched_at_or_null <= marker.start_deadline_at; marker creation/validation failure has a null marker, while a valid marker followed by spawn/no-launch failure keeps the marker nonnull; either no-launch path has null launched_at_or_null and timeout terminates exactly at state_entry_at+30 seconds; a receipt may not hide an existing valid marker; a launched-process timeout terminates from watchdog through watchdog+30 seconds and every other launched status terminates at or before watchdog
development_terminal_receipt.status_and_nullability: pass/fail require nonnull launched_at and controller_synthesized false; every other status has null outcome aggregates and may be controller-synthesized; only a no-launch timeout has null launched_at
development_terminal_receipt.binding_rule: packet manifest, stack binding, and analysis plan equal the implementation_stack_freeze_receipt; only terminal_status pass authorizes public evaluation

public_terminal_receipt.time_rule: controller_state_predecessor resolves as a validator-valid development_terminal_receipt with status pass and state_entry_at equals predecessor.terminated_at; a present launch marker has phase public-evaluation, watchdog_deadline_at equal state_entry_at+3600 seconds, and a process launch has marker.consumed_at <= launched_at_or_null <= marker.start_deadline_at; marker creation/validation failure has a null marker, while a valid marker followed by spawn/no-launch failure keeps the marker nonnull; either no-launch path has null launched_at_or_null and timeout terminates exactly at state_entry_at+30 seconds; a receipt may not hide an existing valid marker; a launched-process timeout terminates from watchdog through watchdog+30 seconds and every other launched status terminates at or before watchdog; controller_handoff_deadline_at equals terminated_at+30 seconds
public_terminal_receipt.status_and_nullability: pass/fail require nonnull launched_at and controller_synthesized false; crash, invalid-output, and inconclusive require nonnull launched_at and may be controller-synthesized only when the evaluator failed to emit a validator-valid terminal artifact; timeout may have null launched_at only for the no-launch deadline and is controller-synthesized
public_terminal_receipt.binding_rule: packet manifest, stack binding, and analysis plan equal the predecessor development receipt and are the exact frozen artifacts later required by both reader launch-attempt markers; no public metric or case content is present

reader_terminal_receipt.status_and_nullability: pass/fail require nonnull attempt, consumption, launched_at, and aggregate with controller_synthesized false; crash/invalid-output/inconclusive/timeout require nonnull attempt, consumption, and launched_at, null aggregate, controller_synthesized true; launch-failure requires nonnull attempt and consumption but null launched_at/aggregate with controller_synthesized true; launch-integrity-failure permits null attempt only for attempt-marker failure and requires null consumption/launched_at/aggregate with controller_synthesized true
reader_terminal_receipt.cross_artifact_equalities: reader_id, partition, controller predecessor SHA-256/bytes, packet manifest, stack binding, analysis plan, and watchdog equal every present launch marker; shadow controller predecessor resolves as public_terminal_receipt and holdout controller predecessor resolves as the embargoed reader_terminal_receipt for shadow; predecessor terminal time <= attempt.consumed_at <= consumption.consumed_at <= launched_at <= watchdog_deadline_at when those values exist, and every launched_at is no later than the attempt marker controller_handoff_deadline_at; watchdog_deadline_at equals attempt consumed_at plus 3600 seconds when attempt exists and otherwise predecessor terminal time plus 3600 seconds; terminated_at is not before every applicable predecessor/attempt/launch instant; timeout requires watchdog_deadline_at <= terminated_at <= watchdog_deadline_at+30 seconds, while every other validated terminal receipt is at or before its watchdog deadline
reader_terminal_receipt.handoff_deadline_rule: for pass, fail, crash, invalid-output, inconclusive, or timeout, controller_handoff_deadline_at equals terminated_at+30 seconds; launch-failure and launch-integrity-failure inherit the attempt marker's controller_handoff_deadline_at; when the attempt marker is null, shadow derives public_predecessor.terminated_at+30 seconds while holdout inherits shadow_predecessor.controller_handoff_deadline_at; those synthetic launch statuses terminate no later than that inherited deadline, so chained shadow-to-holdout failure handling never receives a fresh 30-second window
reader_terminal_receipt.aggregate_measurements_or_null: the exact partition-specific registry below only for validated pass/fail; null for every controller-synthesized terminal status

aggregate_measurements_schema.point_metric_type: finite JSON number, except agent_triggered_byte_mismatch_count is a nonnegative non-boolean integer; either may be null iff the same metric has a nonnull failure reason and the partition gate boolean is false; NaN, infinity, and fractional mismatch counts are forbidden
aggregate_measurements_schema.metric_failure_reason_keys: exactly holdout_point_metric_keys_exactly or shadow_point_metric_keys_exactly for that partition
aggregate_measurements_schema.pass_nullability_rule: terminal_status is pass iff every point metric has its exact valid type, every failure reason is null, the post-run floor applies where required, and the recomputed partition gate boolean is true
aggregate_measurements_schema.fail_nullability_rule: terminal_status is fail iff the recomputed partition gate boolean is false; it may carry typed failed-gate values or typed nulls, and each null has exactly one nonnull enum reason
aggregate_measurements_schema.ci_type: finite JSON number, or null iff invalid_replicate_count is nonzero
aggregate_measurements_schema.uncertainty_binding: full_sample_point_estimate equals its mapped outer point metric; resamples equals 10000; seed equals 588763221 for automatic/novel metrics, 1632232291 for organic/agent metrics, and 2220152078 for shadow metrics; component_count equals the corresponding exact outer component count and observation_count equals the complete untrimmed cohort opportunity count
aggregate_measurements_schema.gate_recomputation: the verifier recomputes every frozen operator against the exact outer point metric, typed failure reason, post-run counts, and uncertainty registry; a supplied gate boolean is not trusted
aggregate_measurements_schema.all_point_gates_pass: joint confirmation requires both partition-specific gate booleans true and every other frozen gate true

reader_launch_attempt_marker.predecessor_rule: shadow maps to an exact public_terminal_receipt and holdout maps to an exact embargoed reader_terminal_receipt for shadow; consumed_at is at or after that artifact's terminated_at and no later than controller_handoff_deadline_at; for shadow that deadline equals public.terminated_at+30 seconds, while for holdout it equals the predecessor shadow receipt's controller_handoff_deadline_at
reader_launch_attempt_marker.handoff_deadline_rule: controller_handoff_deadline_at is the nonresetting deadline derived by predecessor_rule; marker creation, validation, consumption-marker creation, and evaluator spawn must all complete no later than it

reader_launch_consumption_marker.cross_artifact_equalities: reader_id, partition, packet manifest, stack binding, launcher, plan, watchdog deadline, and controller handoff deadline equal the attempt marker; attempt.consumed_at <= consumed_at <= controller_handoff_deadline_at, and evaluator launched_at when present is also no later than that deadline
reader_launch_consumption_marker.overwrite_second_marker_or_spawn_failure: authority remains consumed; controller emits the corresponding aggregate terminal receipt and advances the unconditional sequence

joint_reader_release_manifest.embedded_receipt_schema: shadow_terminal_receipt is exactly reader confirmatory-shadow-v3-eval/partition shadow and holdout_terminal_receipt exactly confirmatory-holdout-v3-eval/partition holdout; each recursively satisfies reader_terminal_receipt and hashes to its adjacent identity; both have identical packet manifest, analysis plan, and stack binding equal same_stack_binding_sha256_and_bytes
joint_reader_release_manifest.time_rule: both terminal receipts precede or equal created_at and holdout.terminated_at <= created_at <= holdout.controller_handoff_deadline_at; synthetic failure chains retain their inherited original deadline rather than receiving another 30 seconds
joint_reader_release_manifest.publication: write and fsync one private same-filesystem temp envelope containing both embedded receipts, fsync parent, then use one atomic no-replace visibility operation; private receipt files are never directly visible
joint_reader_release_manifest.recovery: validate and atomically publish an existing private temp under the original 30-second deadline, or validate an existing final envelope; never overwrite, split, or publish one receipt alone

cohorts.unseen_repeated_automatic: every replayable holdout automatic event belonging to a replayable-event-qualified repeated family absent from the complete frozen-dev automatic reference
cohorts.organic: every replayable selected holdout event with persisted agent IS NOT NULL

content_ref_resolver.environment: fresh isolated read-only clone of the corresponding arm's pre-call sealed node state

latency_measure.stop: immediately after the complete MCP response is received and parsed

construction.source_retrieval_policy_key_validation: exactly replayability.shared_seed_state_validation; policy-key allowlist plus explicit supported concrete learned-policy-key mapping; never a node memory-scope predicate

construction.recall_events: empty at seed; no pre-boundary or candidate recall event is copied

state_isolation.shadow_and_holdout: separate fresh clones with no shared mutable database, history, session, cache, or process

candidate clone SHA-256 and bytes before execution

arm_schedule.barrier: both paired responses complete before either arm advances to the next canonical event

metric_definitions.shadow_latency_p95_degradation: nearest-rank candidate p95 / nearest-rank gating-off p95 - 1 over shadow
